meta.title: Native Collaboration Bundle
meta.description: Manage subagent settings, communication, Team model selection and automatic wake-ups. Settings load automatically and changes save automatically.

collabUi.title: Collaboration component diagnostics
collabUi.summary: Child-agent communication, Team model selection, and consecutive automatic wake-up limit.
collabUi.statusPlaceholder: This component does not run standalone; tools are loaded on demand with conversations.
collabUi.statusRootScope: This read-only table shows root components, not feature toggles. Control, list, spawn, and fork tools load with AgentPresets; off at root is normal. Do not enable them just to make every row green.
collabUi.statusReadOnly: Diagnostics do not change settings or prove tool availability in every chat.
collabUi.transactionUnavailable: Settings cannot be saved safely right now. Refresh settings and retry.
collabUi.sourceUnknown: This root inventory cannot identify the entry source.
collabUi.unknownNotice: Some current settings could not be determined.
collabUi.unknownStructure: The component inventory is incomplete or its source is unrecognized. Current state is unconfirmed.
collabUi.statusError: Unable to confirm component status. Please refresh. If this persists, keep the error code and diagnostics for troubleshooting.
collabUi.capabilityImpact: Enable child-agent and Team enhancements separately in plugin settings. Turning enhancements off does not remove permissions or conversations.
collabUi.lifecycleInstall: After installation the management entry loads background services automatically, and enhancement settings save as you change them. Changes that need a restart apply after you restart the same working profile normally.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.subagent: This service starts with the management entry; it is not a feature toggle. Change enhancements in plugin settings and restart after saving.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.control: This is an AgentPreset tool, not a root background service. Verify it in an actual chat.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.listAgents: This is an AgentPreset tool, not a root background service. Verify it in an actual chat.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.agentTeam: This service starts with the management entry; it is not a feature toggle. Change enhancements in plugin settings and restart after saving.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.teamTools: This service starts with the management entry; it is not a feature toggle. Change enhancements in plugin settings and restart after saving.
collabUi.lifecycleRemove: Wait for running tasks to finish, then disable or uninstall the plugin and restart the current working profile. If it no longer starts after uninstalling or after a failed uninstall, follow the project FAQ and the plugin notes to recover manually: inspect the external startup override files in the Profile directory, then remove or correct them as described and start again.
collabUi.lifecycleSidecar: Uninstalling keeps conversations and logs. The consecutive automatic wake-up counter lives only in process memory and resets on restart.

collabUi.settingsSummary: Subagent settings, communication, Team enhancements and automatic wake-ups
collabUi.settingsScope: Settings load automatically and valid changes save automatically. Subagent settings share the original DSH configuration. Model source applies to subsequent queries and creation; restart-required enhancements apply after restarting this Profile.
collabUi.restartRequired: Settings saved. Options requiring a restart take effect after restarting the Profile, without interrupting ongoing chats.
collabUi.modelSourceConversation: Child-model list captured when the conversation started (native setting)
collabUi.modelSourceSettings: Child-model list in current DSH settings
collabUi.modelSourceAll: All models currently available in DSH
collabUi.autoSaveDescription: Changes save automatically, with status or errors beside the affected section. No manual reload or save button is needed.
collabUi.nativeCompatNote: This changes how candidate models are listed, not model permissions. It also affects ordinary child Agents.
collabUi.communicationOffNote: Turning enhancements off does not disable native messaging or stop running tasks.
collabUi.quotaRemains: Default limit is 32 consecutive automatic wake rounds, shared by all Agents associated with the session. Only uninterrupted automatic cross-session wake-ups and messages without user input are counted. Any human input in a related session resets the count. Completion and stop reports to the direct parent or Lead are exempt. The counter is in memory and resets on process restart.
collabUi.write.saved-pending-restart: This setting was saved. Changes requiring a restart apply after a normal Profile restart without interrupting the current chat.
collabUi.write.settings-missing: The settings target could not be verified; no save was sent. Keep your draft and reload settings. If it persists, provide versions and the safe error code.
collabUi.write.settings-unverified: The settings target could not be verified; no save was sent. Keep your draft and reload settings. If it persists, provide versions and the safe error code.
collabUi.write.namespace-unverified: The settings target could not be verified; no save was sent. Keep your draft and reload settings. If it persists, provide versions and the safe error code.
collabUi.write.revision-missing: The settings target could not be verified; no save was sent. Keep your draft and reload settings. If it persists, provide versions and the safe error code.
collabUi.write.not-writable: Settings are read-only or write access is unverified. No save was sent. Check the selected Profile and its edit permissions.
collabUi.write.settings-unavailable: Settings have not finished verification and cannot be saved yet. Reload settings if this persists.
collabUi.write.rejected: The save result is unconfirmed; changes may or may not have been written. Keep your draft and reload settings to check saved values before proceeding.
collabUi.write.write-unconfirmed: The save was sent, but the read-back value differs from this change. Success is unconfirmed. Keep the change and reload settings to check.
collabUi.write.conflict: Settings were updated elsewhere; this save was not accepted. Keep your draft, reload the latest settings, and review before saving again.
collabUi.write.empty: No changes to save in this group.
collabUi.write.field-rejected: Invalid input; no save was sent. Toggles must be on or off, and the consecutive automatic wake-up limit must be a valid positive integer.
collabUi.runningChildGuidance: Accept additional instructions while a child Agent works
collabUi.quotaUsageUnknown: There is no live counter on this page. The in-memory count is shared by all Agents associated with the session and resets on human input in any related session or when the process restarts.
collabUi.progressScope: No switch is needed for progress and results. Open the relevant chat or Team panel; this page has no live task view.
collabUi.progressEntry: How to view progress and results
collabUi.progressTeam: Team tasks: return to the originating conversation and open Team at the top. Inspect members, messages, and shared tasks; select a member to open its conversation.
collabUi.progressChild: Independent child Agents: open the child-agent task card in the originating conversation to inspect its status and returned result.
collabUi.progressAction: Add instructions in the originating conversation. To stop work, use that conversation's Stop action. Changing these settings does not stop or restart tasks.
collabUi.pendingRestartYes: Some settings are waiting for a restart.
collabUi.modalPresetUnknown: Verify preset tools in an actual chat. This table does not verify external overlays or all presets.
collabUi.teamDescription: More flexible model selection for Team members. The same selection setting also affects ordinary child Agents. It does not grant access to additional models.
collabUi.selectionSnapshot: Use the model list from the conversation start
collabUi.quotaValidation: Enter a positive safe integer. Zero, negatives, decimals, and out-of-range numbers are not supported.
collabUi.settingsDiagnostics: Advanced diagnostics: saved and current settings
collabUi.write.refreshed: Settings reloaded. Unsaved drafts remain on this page.
collabUi.settingsLoading: Loading settings. Editing will be available after verification.
collabUi.settingsUnavailable: Settings cannot be read or edited yet. See the specific reason.
collabUi.write.refresh-failed: Settings could not be reloaded and verified. Drafts remain on this page and saving is locked. Keep a copy of your draft; reloading the entire page may discard unsaved edits.
collabUi.write.status-refresh-failed: Settings reloaded and drafts were kept, but runtime status is unconfirmed; this does not prove a service failure. You can edit settings and refresh runtime status later.

runtime.title: Current runtime
runtime.nativeNote: Enhanced background services are not attached. Check that the management entry is enabled, save the desired enhancements, and restart this Profile; do not enable internal components individually.
runtime.readyNote: This confirms background services only, not tool availability in all AgentPresets. Verify tools in an actual chat.

failure.ownership-unverified: Runtime assembly conflicts with another component or its inventory is unavailable. Enhanced services were not started. Keep the safe code and review overrides; see the project FAQ for legacy manual configuration rather than toggling internal components.
failure.plugin-start-failed: An enhanced service could not start. Keep the version, affected role, and safe error code. If disabling the plugin, finish tasks first and restart this Profile afterwards.
failure.plugin-cleanup-failed: Service cleanup is unconfirmed. Do not switch or uninstall yet. Verify that this Profile’s host processes have fully stopped and retain redacted diagnostics.
failure.unknown: This service state is unconfirmed. Keep its role and safe error code for diagnosis; do not assume it stopped safely.

write.settings-missing: The settings target could not be verified; no save was sent. Keep your draft and reload settings.

collabUi.diagnosis.remote-unavailable: The plugin page cannot reach the collaboration service right now. Restart the app and reopen this page; if it still fails, follow the plugin notes and the project FAQ to recover.
collabUi.diagnosis.unknown: The action did not complete. Expand the technical details for the diagnostic code, then follow the plugin notes and try again.

limits.title: Subagent settings
limits.help: The native Subagent settings page is unavailable while this plugin is enabled, so this section edits those settings on its behalf. Changes are written to the original DSH Subagent configuration; changes made there also affect this plugin. With recursion depth 0, subagents cannot create subagents. Existing multi-level subagents are not stopped.
limits.saved: Saved automatically and synchronized with the original DSH Subagent settings.
limits.invalid: Depth must be a whole number of 0 or more; parallelism must be a whole number of 1 or more. Both must be within the safe integer range.
limits.readonly: The native configuration is overridden or its write target cannot be confirmed. Limits are read-only.
limits.unavailable: Subagent settings could not be loaded and verified automatically. Editing is locked; reopen the plugin settings page to try again.
limits.conflict: The configuration changed elsewhere; this change was not saved and your draft is kept. Keep a copy of your draft and reopen the plugin settings page to review the latest values.
limits.saveFailed: Automatic save could not be confirmed; your draft is kept. Keep a copy of your draft and reopen the plugin settings page to check saved values before retrying.
